title: CHAPTER 030 - Accept v3.6 and bootstrap 10-chapter queue
description: Full automated chapter. Closes v3.6 acceptance using existing PASS_NO_RETRY evidence, then creates and arms a queue controller for ten prebuilt chapters 031-040. The controller promotes the next task only after the previous task reaches terminal state in 3en-agent.state.json. Approval remains per chapter. The sequence includes SUCCESS, intentional FAILED_SCRIPT, intentional FAILED_TEST, REJECTED, recovery validation, and final queue acceptance.
